title: KP page directory and algebra caller

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Human-approved exact 30-slice proposal, boundaries, checks, and stop conditions.

allowedWork: Development toolbar protocol, DOM, CSS, dependency-light page directory metadata, supported development-only route mounts, and scoped checks.
A new fraction-composition kp.article.v1 source, lock, vignette, static-first route, minimum caller-proven shared seams, and exact verification evidence.
disallowedWork: Learner-facing global navigation, layout redesign, article grammar changes, a new semantic model, renderer, or clock.
User economics edits, advanced CodeMirror features, Internal Studio, Public Web, Graph3D, Lisp promotion, and matrix-vector work.
goal: Make every supported development page reachable from a host-owned bottom Pages directory, then publish and verify a compact fraction-composition algebra article as the second kp.article.v1 caller.
commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified slice without staging user economics edits or unrelated files.
stopConditions: Stop if development page-directory code enters production output or an established reader budget regresses.
Stop if a supported link requires test-fixture exposure, cross-repository mutation, or destructive work.
Stop if the algebra caller requires changing the frozen article grammar, replacing canonical fraction-composition semantics, or introducing another clock.
Stop if user-owned economics changes would need to be overwritten or committed.
Stop if deterministic checks cannot establish semantic correctness or direct state reconstruction.
Stop at slice s30 for mandatory human visual and editorial review.
